title: Refused
description: board-host to board page: a message it refused and why (AD-7, AD-11). Before a socket's connect is accepted, a refusal (reason token, or version for a first message of another major) is followed at once by a close with code 4403, and the page does not reconnect on its own: it shows the ask as discarded. Once connect is accepted, a refusal leaves the socket open and the ask unchanged: reason message for a message outside the schema, version for a message of another major, answer for an answer command ask-core refuses, naming the item; act for an act command ask-core refuses, naming the command's action ID, the refused act's index and its item; closed for an act command on a closed ask, naming the action ID. Each refusal of a command is followed by a state message. The detail is text for people, at most 1,000 characters, which board-host cuts to fit; no receiver acts on it.
